win.en: Slow and steady wins the race.

carry.en: He carried the books to the library.

such.en: Why are you in such a hurry?
I have never seen such a big tree.
such.cn: 我从没见过这么大的树。

proud.en: The hare was too proud and lost the race.
proud.cn: 兔子太骄傲了，输掉了比赛。

careless.en: He was careless and fell down.

patient.en: Be patient, and you will succeed.

sad.en: The hare was sad when he lost.
sad.cn: 兔子输了的时候很伤心。

steady.en: Slow and steady wins the race.

tortoise.en: The tortoise is in the garden.
The tortoise walked slowly but never stopped.

hare.en: A hare crashed into the tree and died.
hare.cn: 一只兔子撞到树上死了。

another.en: He waited for another hare to come.
another.cn: 他等着另一只兔子过来。

crash.en: The car crashed into the wall.
The hare crashed into a big tree.
crash.cn: 兔子撞到了一棵大树上。

into.en: The hare crashed into the tree.

ground.en: The hare lay on the ground.

die.en: His crops died because he didn't take care of them.
die.cn: 因为他不照料，庄稼都死了。

pick up.en: The farmer picked up the hare and took it home.
pick up.cn: 农夫把兔子捡起来带回了家。

easy.en: He thought it was easy to get food.
easy.cn: 他觉得弄到食物很容易。

himself.en: The farmer talked to himself under the tree.

from then on.en: From then on, I was happy.
From then on, he studied hard.
From then on, he didn't work in the field.
from then on.cn: 从那以后，他就不在田里干活了。

stop.en: He stopped working in the field.
stop.cn: 他停止了在田里的劳作。

animal.en: Many animals live in the forest.
animal.cn: 许多动物生活在森林里。

endangered.cn: 我们应该保护濒危动物。

panda.en: Pandas live in the bamboo forests of China.
panda.cn: 熊猫生活在中国的竹林里。

elephant.en: The elephant has a long trunk.
Elephants are the largest land animals.
elephant.cn: 大象是陆地上最大的动物。

whale.en: The blue whale is the largest animal in the world.
whale.cn: 蓝鲸是世界上最大的动物。

giraffe.en: The giraffe has a long neck.
Giraffes eat leaves from tall trees.
giraffe.cn: 长颈鹿吃高高的树上的叶子。

tiger.en: The tiger is a big cat.
tiger.cn: 老虎是一种大型猫科动物。

tiger.en: Tigers are in danger and we must protect them.
tiger.cn: 老虎处于危险中，我们必须保护它们。

protect.en: We can protect their homes and keep them safe.
protect.cn: 我们可以保护它们的家园，让它们安全。

save.en: Every small action can save endangered animals.
save.cn: 每一个小行动都能拯救濒危动物。

in danger.en: Pandas are in danger because of pollution.
in danger.cn: 熊猫因污染而处于危险中。

kill.en: People kill animals for their fur.
kill.cn: 人们为了皮毛而猎杀动物。

forest.en: People cut down forests and animals lose their homes.
forest.cn: 人们砍伐森林，动物失去了家园。

river.cn: 被污染的河水让鱼生病。

pollute.en: Factories polluted the river last year.
pollute.cn: 去年工厂污染了这条河。

clean.en: I clean my room every day.
We should keep the river clean for the fish.
clean.cn: 我们应该让河水保持干净，为了鱼儿。

helpful.cn: 他是一个乐于助人的男孩。

helpful.en: Your actions are helpful to the animals.
helpful.cn: 你的行动对动物很有帮助。

disappear.en: The sun disappeared in the clouds.
Many animals disappeared because of pollution.
disappear.cn: 许多动物因污染而消失了。

Earth.en: We should protect the Earth and all animals.
Earth.cn: 我们应该保护地球和所有动物。

forever.en: We don't want the animals to disappear forever.
forever.cn: 我们不希望动物们永远消失。

fur.en: Some people kill animals for their fur.
fur.cn: 有些人为了皮毛猎杀动物。

made.en: This bag is made of paper.
Don't buy things made from animal fur.
made.cn: 不要买用动物皮毛做的东西。

make from.en: This bag is made from plastic.
Coats are sometimes made from animal fur.
make from.cn: 外套有时是用动物皮毛做的。

only.en: There are only a few pandas left in the wild.
only.cn: 野外只剩下很少的熊猫了。

famous.en: Dr Sun Yatsen is famous all over the world.
famous.cn: 孙中山先生全世界闻名。

leader.en: Dr Sun Yatsen was a great leader of China.
leader.cn: 孙中山先生是中国伟大的领袖。

born.en: He was born in 1866 in Guangdong.

history.en: Dr Sun Yatsen is important in Chinese history.
history.cn: 孙中山先生在中国历史上很重要。

free.en: The birds are free in the sky.
free.cn: 鸟儿在天空中自由飞翔。

free.en: He wanted to free the Chinese people.

change.en: I want to change my room.
change.cn: 我想改造一下我的房间。

change.en: He worked hard to change China and help the people.
change.cn: 他努力改变中国，帮助人民。

respect.en: People respect Dr Sun Yatsen very much.
respect.cn: 人们非常尊敬孙中山先生。

named after.cn: 我的名字是以我爷爷的名字命名的。

named after.en: The park is named after him.
named after.cn: 这公园以他的名字命名。

named after.en: Many streets in China are named after Dr Sun Yatsen.
named after.cn: 中国很多街道都以孙中山先生命名。

scientist.en: I want to be a scientist.
A scientist works in a lab.
Deng Jiaxian was a great scientist of China.
scientist.cn: 邓稼先是中国伟大的科学家。

clever.en: When he was a child, he was clever and hard-working.
clever.cn: 他小时候就聪明又勤奋。

thoughtful.en: A thoughtful boy thinks a lot.
thoughtful.cn: 爱思考的男孩想得很多。

thoughtful.en: He was a quiet and thoughtful child.
thoughtful.cn: 他是一个安静、爱思考的孩子。

contribution.en: Deng Jiaxian made great contributions to China.
contribution.cn: 邓稼先为中国做出了巨大贡献。

quiet.en: In the library, we should be quiet.
quiet.cn: 在图书馆里，我们应该保持安静。

all one's life.en: He worked hard all his life.
Deng Jiaxian worked for the country all his life.
all one's life.cn: 邓稼先一生都在为国家工作。

polite.cn: 他是一个有礼貌的男孩。

polite.en: It's polite to queue up at the bus stop.
polite.cn: 在公交站排队是礼貌的。

impolite.en: It's impolite to talk loudly in the library.
impolite.cn: 在图书馆里大声说话不礼貌。

manner.cn: 我们应该有良好的礼仪。

manner.en: Good manners make life better for everyone.
manner.cn: 良好的礼仪让每个人生活更美好。

queue.en: Everyone should queue up when waiting for the bus.
queue.cn: 每个人等公交时都应该排队。

push in.en: It's not polite to push in when others are waiting.
push in.cn: 别人排队时插队是不礼貌的。

loudly.en: We shouldn't talk loudly in the library.
loudly.cn: 我们在图书馆不该大声说话。

quietly.en: We should speak quietly in the reading room.
quietly.cn: 在阅览室里我们应该小声说话。

please.en: Can you pass me the book, please?
please.cn: 请你把那本书递给我好吗？

sorry.en: I'm sorry for pushing in line just now.

excuse me.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
Excuse me, where is the nearest library?
excuse me.cn: 请问，最近的图书馆在哪？

friendly.en: A friendly smile can make someone's day better.
friendly.cn: 友好的微笑能让别人的一天更美好。

travel.en: I want to travel around the world one day.

visit.en: I visit my grandma on Sundays.
We will visit the Great Wall this summer.
visit.cn: 今年夏天我们要参观长城。

plane.en: We go to Beijing by plane.
The plane takes about three hours to fly to Beijing.
plane.cn: 飞机飞到北京大约需要三小时。

train.en: I take the train to school.
I will take a train to Shanghai next week.
train.cn: 下周我要坐火车去上海。

holiday.en: Where will you go this summer holiday?

can't wait to.en: I can't wait to open it.
I can't wait to see my old friends again.
can't wait to.cn: 我迫不及待想再见到我的老朋友们。

send.en: I will send you some photos from my trip.
send.cn: 我会把旅行的照片发给你。

email.en: I write emails to my cousin.
Please write an email to me when you arrive.
email.cn: 你到了请给我发一封邮件。

photo.en: I will take many photos at the Great Wall.
photo.cn: 我会在长城拍很多照片。

hometown.en: I will go back to my hometown this holiday.

foolish.en: It was foolish of the hare to take a rest.
foolish.cn: 兔子中途休息真是愚蠢。

silly.en: You are like that silly hare.
silly.cn: 你就像那只傻兔子一样。

in such a hurry.en: I'm in such a hurry today.
Why are you in such a hurry, Jiamin?

happen (to).en: Something strange happened to the hare.
happen (to).cn: 兔子身上发生了一件怪事。

appear.en: A rainbow appeared in the sky.
The farmer waited for another hare to appear.
appear.cn: 农夫等着另一只兔子出现。

go for it.en: If you want to win, go for it.
Don't wait for another hare — go for it!
go for it.cn: 别等下一只兔子——加油去做吧！

frog.en: Is it a frog? No, it's a kangaroo.

kangaroo.en: It has two strong back legs — it's a kangaroo.
kangaroo.cn: 它有两条强壮的后腿——是袋鼠。

turn.en: My turn. This animal looks like a star.
turn.cn: 轮到我了。这种动物长得像星星。

ocean.en: It lives in the ocean and looks like a star.
ocean.cn: 它生活在海洋里，长得像星星。

starfish.en: Is it a starfish? Yes, it is.

Africa.en: There are many animals in Africa.
Lions live in Africa, not in Asia.
Africa.cn: 狮子生活在非洲，不在亚洲。

Asia.en: Tigers live in Asia, not Africa.
Asia.cn: 老虎生活在亚洲，不在非洲。

lion.en: The lion is called the King of the Animals.
It is also called the "King of the Animals" — a lion.
lion.cn: 它也被称为“动物之王”——狮子。

neck.en: A giraffe has a long neck.
Its long neck helps it reach the leaves.

leaf.en: Giraffes eat leaves from tall trees.
leaf.cn: 长颈鹿吃高高树上的叶子。

sea.en: The sea is deep and blue.
Whales and starfish live in the sea.
sea.cn: 鲸鱼和海星生活在海里。

be called.en: This animal is called a panda.
The lion is called the "King of the Animals".

person.en: Only one person can go in.
Dr Sun Yatsen is a famous person in Chinese history.
person.cn: 孙中山是中国历史上有名的人物。

inventor.cn: 爱迪生是伟大的发明家。

inventor.en: The inventor of the light bulb was Thomas Edison.
inventor.cn: 电灯泡的发明者是托马斯·爱迪生。

light bulb.en: The light bulb is very bright.

bulb.en: He put a new bulb in the lamp.
bulb.cn: 他给台灯换了一个新灯泡。

movie.en: We watched a movie last night.
movie.cn: 昨晚我们看了一部电影。

movie.en: I want to see all the famous movie stars in Hollywood.
movie.cn: 我想在好莱坞看到所有著名电影明星。

musician.en: A musician plays music every day.

musician.cn: 莫扎特是一位著名的音乐家。

university.en: Deng Jiaxian went to university in 1941.
university.cn: 邓稼先 1941 年进入大学。

invent.en: You can invent something new and useful, like Edison.
invent.cn: 你可以像爱迪生那样发明新奇有用的东西。

atomic.en: Deng Jiaxian is often called the father of Chinese atomic science.
atomic.cn: 邓稼先常被称为中国原子科学之父。

province.en: Anhui is a province in China.
Deng was born in Anhui Province on June 25, 1924.
province.cn: 邓稼先 1924 年 6 月 25 日生于安徽省。

professor.en: The professor teaches at the university.
His father was a famous professor.
professor.cn: 他的父亲是一位著名教授。

physics.en: He taught physics at Beijing University.
physics.cn: 他在北京大学教物理学。

the United States.en: Washington is in the United States.
In 1948 Deng went to the United States to study physics.
the United States.cn: 1948 年邓稼先赴美攻读物理学。

manners.en: Manners can be quite different in different countries.
manners.cn: 不同国家的礼仪差别很大。

seat.en: I'll give my seat to the old lady on the bus.
seat.cn: 我会把座位让给公交上的那位老太太。

line.en: I waited in line at the supermarket.

push.en: A girl tried to push in the line.

full.en: The cup is full of water.
The room was full of toys and chocolates.
full.cn: 房间里满是玩具和巧克力。

dish.en: Mum is washing the bowls and dishes.

laugh.en: The lion laughed and said, "You are so small."

laugh at.en: It's rude to laugh at others.
We should never laugh at people who are different.
laugh at.cn: 我们不应嘲笑与自己不同的人。

light up.en: The inside of the tree lit up brightly.
light up.cn: 树的内部明亮地点亮了。

lead.en: The teacher led us to the garden.
The road led to a room full of toys.
lead.cn: 那条路通向一间满是玩具的房间。

throw.en: He threw the ball to me.
Don't throw things on the ground.

besides.en: Besides good manners, we also need kindness.
besides.cn: 除了礼貌，我们也需要善良。

carry on (with).en: Please carry on with your work.
The sign said, "Carry on with your magic."
carry on (with).cn: 告示上写着：“继续你的魔法。”

upset.en: Tired and upset, the boy cried out.
upset.cn: 又累又难过，小男孩喊了出来。

sign.en: There was a tree with a sign on it.

except.cn: 除 Tom 外大家都来了。

except.en: Inside everything was dark, except for a sign.
except.cn: 里面一片漆黑，只剩一块告示。

abroad.en: If I can travel abroad, I will go to France.
abroad.cn: 如果能出国旅游，我会去法国。

South Africa.en: In South Africa I can see many beautiful mountains.
South Africa.cn: 在南非我可以看到许多美丽的山。

nature.en: Ben loves nature and wants to see the mountains.
nature.cn: Ben 喜欢大自然，想看山。

choose.en: Janet will choose Australia for her trip.
choose.cn: Janet 会选择去澳大利亚旅行。

Sydney.en: Daniel came to Sydney last month.

opera.en: She wants to see the Sydney Opera House.

Sydney Opera House.en: The Sydney Opera House is famous.
I'd like to see the Sydney Opera House one day.
Sydney Opera House.cn: 有一天我想去看悉尼歌剧院。

harbour.en: The Harbour Bridge is near the opera house.
harbour.cn: 海港大桥在歌剧院旁边。

bridge.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is in San Francisco.

Sydney Harbour Bridge.en: The Sydney Harbour Bridge is famous.
Janet wants to see the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
Sydney Harbour Bridge.cn: Janet 想看悉尼海港大桥。

Japan.en: Xiaoling wants to go to Japan to buy a robot.
Japan.cn: Xiaoling 想去日本买机器人。

Tokyo.en: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
Tokyo is a great place to go shopping.
Tokyo.cn: 东京是个购物的好地方。

France.en: Jiamin will go to France for the food.

Paris.en: Paris is the capital of France.
People say that Paris is the food capital of the world.
Paris.cn: 人们说巴黎是世界美食之都。

capital.en: What is the capital of France?
Paris is the food capital of the world.

San Francisco.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is in San Francisco.

Golden Gate Bridge.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is red.
The Golden Gate Bridge is in San Francisco, USA.
Golden Gate Bridge.cn: 金门大桥在美国旧金山。

Tower Bridge.en: Tower Bridge looks like two towers.
Tourists love taking photos of Tower Bridge.
Tower Bridge.cn: 游客们喜欢拍塔桥的照片。

Big Ben.en: Big Ben tells the time every hour.

New Zealand.en: Kiwis are birds from New Zealand.

Wellington.en: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.
Wellington.cn: 惠灵顿是新西兰的首都。

Wellington.en: People in Wellington love the sea.
Wellington.cn: 惠灵顿的人们喜欢大海。

kiwi.en: The kiwi is a national bird of New Zealand.
kiwi.cn: 几维鸟是新西兰的国鸟。

Ottawa.en: Ottawa is the capital of Canada.

maple.en: Maple leaves are red in autumn.
The maple leaf is on Canada's flag.

flag.en: Canada's flag has a maple leaf on it.
flag.cn: 加拿大国旗上有一片枫叶。

Canada.en: John lives in Canada with his family.
Canada.cn: John 和家人住在加拿大。

natural.en: Canada is famous for its natural beauty.
natural.cn: 加拿大以自然美景著名。

beauty.en: The beauty of the lake is amazing.
I want to see the natural beauty of Canada.
beauty.cn: 我想欣赏加拿大的自然美景。

waterfall.en: Canada has beautiful lakes and waterfalls.
waterfall.cn: 加拿大有美丽的湖泊和瀑布。

Chinatown.en: I plan to visit Chinatown in Toronto.
Chinatown.cn: 我打算去多伦多的唐人街。

Toronto.en: Many Chinese people live in Toronto.

passport.en: I finally got my passport last week.
passport.cn: 我上周终于拿到了护照。

book.en: I booked my plane ticket today.

ticket.en: I booked my plane ticket today.

airport.en: I will arrive at the airport on June 12th.
airport.cn: 我将于 6 月 12 日抵达机场。
